title: Stress run file
description: What a client's stress runner records for one renderer on one device in one pass; tools/report.mjs turns one or more of these into the summary. See CLIENTS.md. A value the client cannot measure is null, never a guess.

kit.description: The kit the widgets came from: manifest.json `version` and the widget-sandbox tag or commit.

client.description: The client: Telegram for iOS, Telegram for Android, Telegram Desktop, Telegram macOS, the web client, …

framework.description: The widget-sandbox tag or commit the client is on.

renderer.description: The renderer's name in the client: wkwebview, android-webview, twidget-core, litehtml, blitz, shadow, iframe, …

rendererKind.description: webview: a browser engine draws the ops (WKWebView, Android WebView, the web's iframe or Shadow DOM); own: the client's own engine lays out and paints (TwidgetCore, litehtml, Blitz).

engine.description: Free text: the engine and its version (WebKit 621, Chrome WebView 141, litehtml 0.9, …).

model.description: Device model as the platform reports it (iPhone17,2; SM-A556B; MacBookPro18,1; …), or the CPU on a desktop.

class.description: weak-android: an A55-class phone (or weaker), the device the limits are chosen for.

refreshHz.description: The display's refresh rate during the run.

pass.description: measure: CLIENTS.md's measuring configuration (compat, the quotas out of the way); production: the client's product configuration (strict, the default limits).

config.description: The host configuration: what the runner asked for and, where the host can tell, what it applied (null = the host's default).

loaded.description: The host reported loaded (the widget's scripts ran).

bootMs.description: From creating the host to loaded, ms.

dead.description: Why the runtime stopped, if it did (the host's dead reason, verbatim).

diedAtMs.description: When it stopped, ms after creating the host.

frames.description: The client's own frames during the measuring window, from the platform (CADisplayLink, Choreographer + FrameMetrics, the desktop's frame clock, requestAnimationFrame on the web). Intervals between frames, ms.

dropped.description: Share of display frames missed: sum of (round(interval / frame period) - 1) over sum of round(interval / frame period).

longTaskMs.description: Main-thread time in tasks over 50 ms during the window, where the platform reports it.

mainThreadMsPerSec.description: Main-thread busy time per second, where the platform reports it (a frame timeline, os_signpost, systrace).

renderer.description: Own renderers: the renderer's own work on this widget per frame (applying the batch, style, layout, building and replaying the display list), ms. null for a WebView renderer.

msPerFrame.description: Mean over the frames it worked on.

displayListOps.description: Display list size of the last frame, if the renderer counts it.

host.description: From the host's stats (SandboxStats / onStats) and the ops the renderer received, over the measuring window.

jsMsPerSec.description: Widget JS time per second (stats.jsMs delta / seconds).

opsPerSec.description: Validated ops per second: what the renderer received.

queryMsPerSec.description: Time the host spent answering layout queries, per second.

nodes.description: The validator's node count at the end.

throttledTasks.description: Tasks the CPU quota deferred during the window (0 in the measure pass).

maxBatchOps.description: The largest validated batch since the widget was created.

processMemoryMb.description: Optional: the app's resident memory at the end.

widget.description: The widget's own data-stress, as the sandbox sees it.

fps.description: Its requestAnimationFrame rate over the window: (frames at the end - at the start) / (t at the end - at the start).

maxGap.description: The largest gap between its frames it published during the window, ms.

jank.description: Its frames over 50 ms during the window.

thermal.description: Thermal state at the end, if the platform reports it (nominal, fair, serious, critical; PowerManager's status).

diags.description: Diagnostic kinds the host reported, with counts.
